```{=html}
<a class="emk-logo" href="https://emaki.lol" target="_blank" rel="noopener" hidden><img src="resources/emaki-icon.png" alt="Emaki's icon: a handscroll with a chat on its sheet"></a>
<div class="emk-head">
 <div class="emk-actions">
  <div class="dl"><a class="dl-main no-external" href="https://github.com/alkaline-software/emaki/releases/latest" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="glyph glyph-download"></span><span class="dl-word">Download</span></a></div>
  <a href="https://emaki.lol" class="intro-btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><i class="bi bi-browser-safari"></i> Website</a>
  <a href="https://github.com/alkaline-software/emaki" class="intro-btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><i class="bi bi-github"></i> GitHub</a>
 </div>
</div>
<script>
 // The app's icon belongs beside the post's title, in the title block Quarto
 // writes, which a post's own markup cannot reach: it waits here, hidden,
 // and is moved there as the page is read.
 (function () {
  var logo = document.querySelector(".emk-logo"), title = document.querySelector("#title-block-header .quarto-title");
  if (!logo || !title) return;
  title.appendChild(logo);
  logo.hidden = false;
 })();
</script>
```
